title: Kinematics Fundamentals
notes: - Kinematics is the study of motion without reference to its causes.
- Displacement is the change in position of an object, a vector quantity.
- Velocity is defined as displacement per unit time, v = Δx/Δt.
- Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity, a = Δv/Δt.
- Key equations of motion apply under uniform acceleration only.
